title: Kiosk payment: the checkout and the AP2 v0.2 mandates
description: The checkout an operator signs, the two closed AP2 v0.2 mandates an AI assistant signs to pay it, the POST <endpoint>/pay request body, the settlement it answers and the two receipts in it. On the wire the checkout is a compact PS256 JWT, and each mandate is a compact SD-JWT whose one disclosure is the mandate; these schemas describe the decoded objects.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 ALPHA-3 code, and the `pattern` is the domain: three ASCII letters, either case. An operator MAY refuse more (Section 11.1).

merchant.description: The AP2 Merchant object. In a Kiosk checkout, `id` and `website` are the operator's issuer.

checkout.description: The claims of the `checkout_jwt` an operator answers for an item to pay for: a JWT it signs PS256 with the key of its JWKS (Section 11.7).

iss.description: The operator's issuer, verbatim from kiosk.json.

sub.description: The account the checkout is for. Only that account can pay it.

line_items.description: The first names the item to pay for; the others carry `qty` and `price_cents`, which sum to the total.

sdJwtPayload.description: The payload of the issuer-signed JWT of a mandate. Its header is {"alg": "RS256", "typ": "dc+sd-jwt"}, signed with the AI assistant's registered key. `delegate_payload` holds one digest, and the one disclosure it names is the mandate.

exp.description: At most 24 hours ahead. An exp already in the past is rejected.

checkout_jwt.description: The checkout_jwt the operator answered, unchanged.

checkout_hash.description: The base64url SHA-256 of checkout_jwt, with no padding.

transaction_id.description: The checkout_hash of the checkout mandate.

payee.description: The checkout's merchant: its id is the operator's issuer.

currency.description: The checkout's currency, compared as a code.

id.description: "on_file" pays with the card the human saved through payment_setup.

payRequest.description: The POST <endpoint>/pay request body: the two closed mandates as compact SD-JWT strings.

settlement.description: The pay response body, answered verbatim: there is no envelope, no ok flag and no kind discriminator (protocol.md 8.2, 11.3).

settled_amount_cents.description: The captured amount; equals the checkout total. MUST be positive: a settlement exists only for a completed capture.

currency.description: The currency of the capture, in the OPERATOR's canonical spelling, which MAY differ byte for byte from the spelling in the checkout (protocol.md 11.3, 11.5). Compare it as an ISO 4217 code, never as bytes.

checkout_receipt.description: The AP2 checkout receipt: a compact JWT the operator signs PS256 with the key of its JWKS. Its claims are `checkoutReceipt` (protocol.md 11.3).

payment_receipt.description: The AP2 payment receipt: a compact JWT the operator signs PS256 with the key of its JWKS. Its claims are `paymentReceipt` (protocol.md 11.3).

compactJwt.description: A compact JWS: three base64url segments.

checkoutReceipt.description: The claims of the checkout receipt a successful pay answers (AP2 v0.2 checkout_receipt.json, status Success).

reference.description: The reference of the checkout mandate: the base64url SHA-256 of its compact SD-JWT.

order_id.description: The id in the first line item of the checkout.

paymentReceipt.description: The claims of the payment receipt a successful pay answers (AP2 v0.2 payment_receipt.json, status Success). `network_confirmation_id` is present only when the payment provider reports it; AP2 requires it, so a receipt without it does not satisfy AP2's schema (protocol.md 11.3).

reference.description: The reference of the payment mandate: the base64url SHA-256 of its compact SD-JWT.

network_confirmation_id.description: The card network's id of the transaction.
